text: dsh-blue-whale 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的蓝鲸配色主题。它通过浏览器端模块覆盖品牌主题变量，并在“设置 → 常规”加入开关，同时调整侧栏和欢迎页鲸标、浏览器标签图标、按钮与交互强调色。主题开关状态保存在浏览器中，亮色和深色模式沿用 DSH 的外观设置。适合希望将 DSH 网页界面改为 DeepSeek Chat 蓝色风格的用户；安装后默认启用，无需额外账号或密钥。

dsh-blue-whale themes the DSH web client with DeepSeek Chat blue across brand tokens, whale marks, favicon, and buttons. A Settings → General switch controls the skin and saves its state in the browser. Light and dark follow DSH appearance. Enabled by default; no extra account or key is needed.
想把 DSH 网页界面的鲸鱼标志换成蓝色
有没有能给 DSH 网页版换品牌配色的主题
让 DSH 的按钮和强调色变成 DeepSeek Chat 的蓝色
我想在设置里开关一个蓝色外观皮肤
浏览器标签页图标也能跟着主题换成蓝色吗
DSH 的亮色和深色模式能保留，同时换一套品牌色吗
Can I recolor the DSH web interface with DeepSeek blue?
I want a browser theme that changes the whale logo and accent buttons in DSH.
dsh-blue-whale 的功能「蓝鲸品牌配色」：将 DSH 的品牌变量、按钮和交互强调色覆盖为蓝鲸蓝，并分别提供亮色与深色调色值。主题颜色通过 DSH 的主题接口应用。
dsh-blue-whale 的功能「鲸标和浏览器图标」：启用主题后，侧栏及欢迎页鲸标采用蓝色，浏览器标签图标也会尝试改为蓝色版本；关闭主题时恢复默认图标。
dsh-blue-whale 的功能「设置页开关」：在“设置 → 常规”提供带状态提示的开关。点击后立即应用或移除皮肤，并把启用状态写入浏览器存储。

dsh-blue-whale README · dsh-blue-whale：English · [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.

DSH ships as a black whale. [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com) is a blue one. This plugin puts Chat blue `#4D6BFE` on the wordmark, hero fish, tab favicon, and primary actions. Light / dark / follow-system stay on the built-in Appearance setting.

dsh-blue-whale README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-blue-whale
```

GitHub fallback:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:starslittle/dsh-blue-whale
```

Restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R). The skin is **on by default**.

Open **Settings → General → Blue Whale**. A green dot means it is on. **Turn off** matches the stock capsule control; **Turn on** is the blue fill.

dsh-blue-whale README · Check that it loaded：| What you see | What to do |
|---|---|
| Sidebar whale and `deepseek` letters are blue | It is on |
| Still the black whale | Restart, then hard-refresh |
| Turning the switch off restores the stock colors | Expected |

dsh-blue-whale README · What it changes：| | Stock DSH | This skin |
|---|---|---|
| Sidebar whale + `deepseek` | near-black / near-white | `#4D6BFE` |
| Hero whale | same | `#4D6BFE` |
| Browser tab icon | black (white in OS dark) | `#4D6BFE` |
| Brand / send / accents | black or white | `#4D6BFE` |
| Page background | built-in light / dark | unchanged |
| Light / dark switch | built-in Appearance | still built-in |

Supporting colors come from DSH's own `--dsw-static-deepseek-*` scale.

dsh-blue-whale README · What it does not do：- It does not change layout or density
- It does not change a desktop shell's window or tray icon
- Headless and TUI profiles have nothing to paint

Turning it off or uninstalling restores the stock colors immediately.
